Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.perk

Interface PerkService

public interface PerkService
Rank-based limits from perks.yml: named tiers tied to permissions, and temporary boosts given to single players.

A player holds every enabled tier whose permission they have, and is shown as belonging to the highest-priority one. The resolution mode decides where each perk comes from: that tier, or the best value among all the tiers they hold. A tier's value comes from the tier itself, then up its parent chain. Every perk no tier gives, and every perk of a player without a tier, follows the server-wide default: settings.yml for host limits, party size and scenario settings, the defaults of perks.yml for the rest, and an addon's own default for its perks. Active personal and server-wide boosts apply on top.

Addons can register perks of their own, which resolve exactly as the built-in ones do. A number value of PerkDefinition.UNLIMITED in perks.yml means unlimited for perks that support it; getNumber(org.bukkit.entity.Player, dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.perk.Perk) answers Integer.MAX_VALUE for it, so limits compare as usual.

Zentrix asks for a perk when the player acts - creating a game, inviting someone - so a rank that expires takes nothing away the player already has. When a perk stops a player, PerkLimitReachedEvent fires.

Reads answer at once, on the main thread, from what Zentrix holds for online players. Boost changes are stored with the player's data, work for offline players and complete on the main thread; they complete exceptionally while storage is unavailable. 


 PerkService perks = ZentrixAPI.get().getPerkService();
 int slots = perks.getNumber(player, Perk.CUSTOM_GAMES_MAX_HOSTED);
 perks.grantBoost(player.getUniqueId(), Perk.CUSTOM_GAMES_MAX_HOSTED, 1, Duration.ofHours(24), "shop");
Since:
1.9.0

      @NotNull @NotNull CompletableFuture<PerkBoost> grantBoost(@NotNull @NotNull UUID playerId, @NotNull @NotNull Perk perk, int amount, @NotNull @NotNull Duration duration, @NotNull @NotNull String source)
      Gives a player a temporary boost, online or offline. It ends on its own after duration.
      Parameters:

      source - who or what gave it, kept with the boost

      Throws:

    • registerPerk

      void registerPerk(@NotNull org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin owner, @NotNull @NotNull PerkDefinition definition)
      Registers an addon perk. From then on tiers in perks.yml can set it under its key, boosts can raise it, and /perks, the tier editor and placeholders (%zentrix_perk_<key>%, dots and dashes as underscores) show it, exactly as they do built-in perks.

      Values and boosts of a perk that is not registered are kept as they are, so an addon that loads late, or is removed for a while, finds them again. The perk is unregistered when its owner disables. Main thread, such as from the addon's onEnable.

      Parameters:
      owner - the addon registering it
      definition - the perk; build one with PerkDefinition.number(java.lang.String) or PerkDefinition.toggle(java.lang.String)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the key is a built-in perk's, or another addon's
      IllegalStateException - off the main thread
      Since:
      1.16.0
